description:
Priority: P2 | Area: ci | Labels: chore,area:ci,P2 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: none | Task: TBD

Follow-up recorded by AI-0074 (bitty-ai): extend the secret-scan CI gate to the docs repositories. Port the canonical implementation from bitty-ai commit f1a435d (read-only reference: git -C $BITTY_WORKSPACE/bitty-ai show f1a435d:.github/workflows/ci.yml and ...:justfile) to this repository, adapting to this repo own pins and toolchain:
1. justfile: add gitleaks_version := "8.30.1" as the single source of truth; add a secrets recipe (gitleaks detect --source . --no-banner) and a gitleaks-version recipe that reports pinned vs local and must not fail on a build without ldflags version metadata.
2. .github/workflows/ci.yml: add a job id secrets, name Secret scan, ubuntu-latest, timeout-minutes: 15, checkout with this repo existing pinned SHA and fetch-depth: 0; an Install checksum-verified gitleaks step that derives the version from the justfile pin (fail-closed when empty), downloads the pinned release tarball plus checksums file, verifies with sha256sum --check --strict, extracts, installs into $HOME/.local/bin and appends it to GITHUB_PATH; then gitleaks detect --source . --no-banner.
3. Keep secrets OUT of the check recipe; no gitleaks-action, no pull_request_target, no new permissions or secrets; keep workflow-level contents: read.
4. Run the scan on this repo history; if it reports false positives, add a minimal .gitleaks.toml with narrowly scoped anchored-path allowlists and record the evidence; otherwise no config file.

Note: the primary checkout currently carries another agent uncommitted .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc and a .targets/ dir - do not touch them; work only from a clean worktree.

Evidence: actionlint on ci.yml, act -n dry run showing the Secret scan job, just secrets result, negative-control check, just check + git diff --check.
title: CI secret-scan gate: pin gitleaks and add a checksum-verified Secret scan job
Record research 039/040 plugin-ecosystem + panel/activity conclusions into docs
